{{Top|leg}}
'''Heavy plating type 2''', a specialized variant of [[Droid heavy plating type 1|heavy plating]], was not sold in mass quantities. Most often, this [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] alloy was used to equip elite troops where the initial cost of the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] warranted the investment.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 2 to be able to equip this item.
